title: Una sociedad jerárquica
goal: Read how the colonial hierarchy was written directly into law, from two parallel legal systems to a grievance that quietly built for three centuries.

items: Describe the two legal spheres colonial society was officially divided into.
Explain what a 'limpieza de sangre' certificate was and why it was required.
Explain why criollos were excluded from the highest colonial offices.
Describe the long-term consequence of that exclusion.
Use se-passive/impersonal constructions to describe a sustained institutional pattern.
